docs.title: 👋 About Me
docs.text: Hi there! I'm Mazhar Hussain, a passionate and detail-oriented Data Analyst 📊 with a knack for turning raw data into meaningful insights. I love solving real-world problems using data, whether it's through dashboards, reports, or deep-dive analysis.

docs.title: 🚀 What I Do
docs.text:
🔍 Data Exploration & Cleaning I thrive on digging into messy datasets and bringing clarity with clean, structured data.

📈 Data Visualization Crafting interactive, insightful dashboards using tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Python (Matplotlib, Seaborn).

📊 Statistical Analysis & Modeling I apply statistical methods to uncover trends and help stakeholders make data-driven decisions.

📁 Reporting & Communication Transforming complex results into clear, actionable reports that speak the language of business.

docs.title: 🛠️ Tools & Tech
docs.text:
• Python 🐍 (Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
  • SQL 🧠 (MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Power BI / Tableau 📊
  • Excel + Advanced Formulas 📑
  • Git & GitHub 🧩
  • Jupyter Notebooks 📓

docs.title: 🧠 Fun Facts
docs.text:
• I have a love-hate relationship with Excel... but we’re working through it! 😅
  • Big fan of hackathons and data challenges 🏁
  • Forever curious and always learning 📚
  • Passionate about making data accessible and beautiful ✨
